newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index down 2.38 percent.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index down 2.38 percent.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index fell 1.77 points, 2.38 percent, to 72.66 points after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index lost 91.75 points or 2.75 pct to end at a provisional 3,250.11.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 11.48 percent.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
